name: Ink Gecko
summary: A sketchbook gecko drawn in thin lines that crawls after your pointer and snaps up bugs
about: A gecko drawn like a pen sketch crawls around the page, breathing, blinking and leaving fading inky footprints. Its body bends smoothly, its feet plant and step in diagonal pairs, and it chases your pointer or the buzzing bugs you drop, snapping them up with an ink splash, a little shake and a score pop. Good for a creative portfolio, a playful background or an about page with character.
how: Move your mouse, or drag a finger, and the gecko turns and crawls after it.
Tap or click to drop a little bug; the gecko hunts it down and flicks out its tongue.
Use Drop a bug from the keyboard, and switch between following you and wandering on its own.
The counter keeps track of how many bugs it has eaten.
With reduced motion it moves at half speed and rests instead of wandering.
